title: Add tasks and list them
spec: add() assigns ids 1,2.., strips titles, rejects blanks; list('all') returns insertion order.

title: Toggle active/done
spec: toggle() flips done; unknown id raises KeyError.

title: Filter active/done
spec: list('active') and list('done') partition; bad filter raises ValueError.

title: Remove and clear completed
spec: remove() deletes; ids never reused; clear_done() removes done, returns count.

title: Snapshot round-trip
spec: to_dict()/from_dict() restores items and id counter exactly.
